sections.skill: Use right-triangle reasoning to make design decisions under constraints

questions.skill: Use right-triangle reasoning to make design decisions under constraints
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 10 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: A ramp must rise 2 feet. Building rules allow at most 1 foot of rise for every 12 feet of horizontal run. What is the shortest allowed run, and how long is the ramp surface, to the nearest tenth of a foot?
questions.prompt_markup:
A ramp must rise 2 feet. Building rules allow at most 1 foot of rise for every 12 feet of horizontal run.
What is the shortest allowed run, and how long is the ramp surface, to the nearest tenth of a foot?
questions.correct_answer: The run is 24 feet; the surface is √(24² + 2²) = √580 ≈ 24.1 feet.

questions.skill: Use right-triangle reasoning to make design decisions under constraints
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 10 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: A 50-inch TV (measured on the diagonal) is 40 inches wide. A cabinet opening is 32 inches tall and 42 inches wide. Does the TV fit? Explain.
questions.prompt_markup:
A 50-inch TV (measured on the diagonal) is 40 inches wide. A cabinet opening is 32 inches tall and 42 inches wide.
Does the TV fit? Explain.
questions.correct_answer: Yes. The TV is 30 inches tall (30² + 40² = 50²), which is less than 32 inches, and 40 inches wide, which is less than 42 inches.
